message:
You know that feeling when you’re not just prepared for a storm, but gloriously over-prepared? Last summer, I found myself with enough bottled water to float a small boat, just as the weather reports were hinting at a heatwave. My family teased me endlessly, calling me the ‘Water Queen’ as they eyed my stash with a mix of amusement and disbelief.

But wouldn’t you know it? When the temperatures soared and my neighbor’s air conditioner gave out, who was the hero? I ended up sharing my water supply, and I think I earned a few brownie points in the process. 

Being ready doesn’t mean you have to go wild, but a little extra can go a long way. What’s your favorite tip for staying calm and collected when the weather gets a little wild? ☔
